posts.title: Hello World
posts.text: Welcome to Hexo! This is your very first post. Check documentation for more info. If you get any problems when using Hexo, you can find the answer in troubleshooting or you can ask me on GitHub. Quick StartCreate a new post1$ hexo new "My New Post" More info: Writing Run server1$ hexo server More info: Server Generate static files1$ hexo generate More info: Generating Deploy to remote sites1$ hexo deploy More info: Deployment

pages.title: Research
pages.text: ResearchMy work focuses on digital health, biomedical engineering, and technology for clinical applications. Intraoperative Neural MonitoringSignal-processing and machine-learning methods for detecting and quantifying neural irritation from intraoperative EMG. Fall Risk and Human MovementSensor fusion using wearable IMUs and plantar-pressure or insole sensing for fall detection and fall-risk assessment. Medical Computer VisionComputer vision and imaging systems for surgical and clinical applications. Digital Health and Medical AISafe deployment, governance, and practical use of artificial intelligence in healthcare.
